continuity: Jin Taekyung, Lee Jungryong, Wu Heixing, and roughly five hundred suicide-squad members are within twenty kilometers of the Arch Lich.
The Arch Lich has retained an estimated fifty thousand monsters as a reserve force, while the front lines contain fewer monsters than the High Command predicted.
Team Leader Choi has correctly inferred that the Arch Lich withheld its reserve to respond to unexpected threats.
Prince Felix, Faye Chen, and Magic Johnson have joined the battlefield, and ten thousand Hunters from the Western and Eastern Fronts are advancing as reinforcements.
Go Jun has become stronger and more controlled, suppressing his killing intent despite Taekyung's provocation.
plot: Jin Taekyung confronts Wu Heixing over protecting himself while his allies died, and Lee Jungryong intervenes to prevent their argument from becoming a fight.

Lee Jungryong reveals that the Arch Lich has kept an estimated fifty thousand monsters in reserve only twenty kilometers from their position. Team Leader Choi infers that the smaller-than-expected front-line forces created enough strength for a counterattack and identifies S-rank Hunters as one-person armies capable of overturning the battle.

Prince Felix, Faye Chen, and Magic Johnson arrive through a dangerous teleport, followed by ten thousand reinforcements from the Western and Eastern Fronts. Team Leader Choi declares that the allied forces will win, and Jin Taekyung believes him.
